title: Last chance to shop Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event before it ends on November 1
summary: Shop thousands of deals across everyday favorites and prestige brands like Armani, Dyson, Tarte, Clinique, and ELEMIS Skincare, along with a wide selection of exclusive gift sets and rotating 48-hour flash deals.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event returns for its sixth year, running October 19 through November 1.


- Customers can save up to 30% across beauty categories, including brands like bareMinerals, Sol de Janeiro, and Lancôme, with 48-hour flash deals rotating across top beauty categories throughout the event.


- The event features thousands of deals across skin care, makeup, hair care, fragrance, wellness, and more.


---


Now in its sixth year, the Amazon Holiday Beauty Event is back—bringing two weeks of deals across skin care, makeup, hair care, fragrance, men’s grooming, personal care, and wellness. Running October 19 through November 1, 2026, the event offers customers up to 30% off prestige brands and everyday beauty staples alike, plus exclusive gift sets and rotating flash deals—all with the fast, free shipping


[Prime members](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-benefits) always enjoy.


The Holiday Beauty Event is one more way


[Amazon helps customers save money](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-affordable-everyday-savings) —making it easier to check everyone off your holiday list without breaking the bank.


Whether you’re getting a head start on holiday gifting or refreshing your own routine before the season kicks into high gear, here’s everything you need to know.


## What deals can you find at the Holiday Beauty Event?


The event features thousands of curated deals spanning the full spectrum of beauty—from prestige names like Armani, Dyson, Tarte, Clinique, and ELEMIS Skincare to everyday go-tos like Olay, Dove, Native, and Cremo. Customers can also shop exclusive gift sets from Burt’s Bees, LANEIGE, and Marc Jacobs, making it easy to find something for everyone on your list at every price point. With deals across every beauty budget, the Holiday Beauty Event helps lower costs on the purchases that matter most—whether that’s a go-to daily essential or a special holiday gift.


Looking for a specific category? With 48-hour flash deals rotating across top categories like skin care, hair care, makeup, and fragrance throughout the two-week event, there’s always a reason to come back and discover deeper savings.

Need help navigating the deals?


[Alexa for Shopping](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/alexa-for-shopping-ai-assistant) uses what it knows about you and its product expertise to make finding and buying what you need more convenient. Try asking, “What are the best skin care deals right now?” or “Help me find a holiday gift set under $50”—and let Alexa do the browsing for you.


Stay tuned for some of the hottest Holiday Beauty Event deals, and visit the


[Amazon Beauty Hub](http://www.amazon.com/beauty) page to shop top selection, limited-time savings, and exclusive gift sets as they drop.
